features.description: Today the pages run intro → Import → Props → Examples → Keyboard → When to use; make it intro → Import → Examples → Keyboard → When to use → Props. Give the example panel's result pane a larger default minimum height

features.title: Redesign the example block and rename it from `example`
features.description: Rethink how it looks, and rename it from `example` to something else. `code` is already taken by the plain code block (`- code: import { Button } from '@bh/ui'`). The rename touches 272 `- example:` entries in 91 `*.doc.yaml` files. BH-1, BH-2 and BH-9 are about the same block, so do them as part of this redesign.

features.description: Don't always show every color. Default to the 6 role tones, and make it configurable: `roles` (default), `hues`, or `all`. The groups already exist as `ROLES`, `HUES` and `TONE_NAMES` in `packages/web/ui/src/style/generated/colors.ts`. Goes with BH-8.

features.title: Fix typography samples cut off with "…" when the line fits
features.description: The sample is capped at `max-w-320` and `truncate`d regardless of the space available. Let it use the column's width, and only truncate when it really doesn't fit (or wrap instead).

features.title: Replace the `registry` prop on every form with a global form provider
features.description: A provider that supplies the registry once.

features.description: Some field calls were inline (`b.text({ name: 'name', label: 'Name', config: {} })`), others broken over lines (~40 vs ~30 across `packages/web/form/docs/examples/*.tsx` and the code blocks in `packages/web/form/docs/*.md`).

features.title: Add `LogView`, a log viewer for any app's logs
features.description: A log viewer in `@bh/ui` for any app's logs. It knows nothing of the app: the app says which lines start a section, and at which level, and adds highlight rules of its own. Planned and built as the gateway's GW-13.

blockedBy.why: planned and built as GW-13's tickets

design.text: https://claude.ai/artifact/373FqCFMX7MWWu3U33K7Nf (done, running, failed, service logs, dark, anatomy).
items: Sections nested to any depth, each folding, with its time and duration; the last and any failed one open, the rest folded.

Highlights by default: timestamps dimmed; errors red, warnings orange (a wash on the line), successes green; ANSI colors drawn in bh's hues, never shown as codes; a Readable / Raw switch for JSON lines.
A multi-line entry (a stack trace) folds under its first line, for logs with no sections.
Follows the end while lines arrive, unless the reader scrolled up ("jump to the end"). No scroll box of its own: the toolbar and the section being read stick to the top of the page.
Find marks matches and opens the folds that hold them; keys ↑ ↓ → ← Enter.
Tests (sections, ANSI parsing, following, thousands of lines staying fast) and a docs page.
